{"question":{"id":"q37","question":"原文是否明确说明墨丘利秘典知道苏天晴并不是这副身体原来的主人？","readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40},"group":"boundary","category":"identity","expected":"不能确认；原文只写古书称苏天晴为适格者，以及苏天晴自问“这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人，难道说……”，这是她的推测性疑问。","certainty":"undetermined","evidence":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29,"quote":"【吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。】"},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"quote":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40,"quote":"这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人，难道说……"}]},"answer":{"queries":4,"sourceQueries":4,"exhausted":false,"answer":{"text":"不，原文没有明确说明“墨丘利秘典知道苏天晴并不是这副身体原来的主人”。第1章第40段原句“这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人，难道说……”是苏天晴的内心推测/疑问，并非叙述确认该书确实知道。已查“墨丘利秘典”仅见第29段的自我介绍；“苏天晴”相关段落中第30段墨丘利秘典称“那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐”，也未直接说明其知道苏天晴非原主。因此目前只能说原文存在苏天晴的推测性表述，不能确认墨丘利秘典明确知道此事。","status":"partial","recordIds":["source-c01"],"sources":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":39},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":1,"query":"墨丘利秘典"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":29,"text":"【吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。】"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":1,"returned":1},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null}]},{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":1,"query":"苏天晴"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":1,"query":"原来的主人"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":1,"query":"并不是"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":5,"text":"“……苏天晴。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":16,"text":"看着在身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，苏天晴鬼使神差地伸手，在尾巴上用力薅了一把。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":27,"text":"“你是谁？”苏天晴扭头正视眼前这本书，茫然地说道。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"text":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":31,"text":"再次听完这中二到能让人用脚趾扣出三室一厅的台词，苏天晴又陷入了沉默与思索。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":39,"text":"嘴上不搭调地回答着古书的话，苏天晴脑子里却也对现状有了个大概的了解。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视
